title: Perfekt (past tense with sein)
description: Learn about Perfekt (past tense with sein) in German.
explanation: The Perfekt tense is used for spoken past in German. It is formed with a helping verb (haben/sein) and the Partizip II at the end of the sentence.

exercises.question: Er ___ gestern ins Kino gegangen.
exercises.explanation: Movement verbs like gehen use sein.
